title: RAW processing history distinguished by a downstream capacity assay
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. Albertus contrasts chewed and pounded wheat by later abscess-maturation capacity. Candidate content preserves processing history through a later capacity attribution without treating that capacity as actual treatment success.

design.author_role: Bounded exploratory producer; root owns predecessor review, scientific selection and any future target binding.

source.author_work: Albert the Great, De anima, Liber II, Tractatus II, chapter VIII
source.complete_unit: Entire chapter, opening enumeration through closing instrument/vehicle statement; read in full on 2026-09-27. Current reader extraction lines 23-38; older receipt line numbers differ.
source.scope_limit: One medieval physiological account, not established modern physiology or source dependence. No source-to-target meaning, picture ownership, seasonal program, or four-to-four mapping follows.

design.whole_unit_debt: The chapter also covers attraction aids, retention, digestive stages and expulsion through several qualities, then bodily instruments and spirit. This card selects one connected argument within that complete unit, not a complete reading or permission to suppress its other content. Appetite and retention must not be silently exchanged in its opening enumeration.
design.access: Full source chapter, named bridge report and receipts. Earlier full-card reads accidentally exposed old f85r2 bindings; see SOURCE_REUSE_SUPPLY_20260927.md. No claim of target blindness. No target source query or image, new admission, reserve, sealed material, external contact or execution.
design.target_scope: No target form, segmentation, figure, participant, paragraph order or word value selected. Every terminal and whole-passage derivation remains unbound.
design.duplicate_status: Bounded CLI metadata screen completed; candidates only, not primary review or certified novelty. No returned card body opened.
design.stop_rule: No interpreter or expanded source corpus at the budget limit. If an explicit complete written contrast cannot be authored without ad hoc values or ownership, retain RAW with that missing binding; do not label it an experimental failure.
design.question: Could a written processing expression constrain a later capacity claim, so that equal starting material kind does not erase the distinction between chewed and pounded products?
design.source_specific_content: To support alteration beginning in the mouth, the chapter gives chewed wheat a maturation power for abscesses that pounded wheat lacks. It places mouth and stomach within one first digestion.
design.source_locus: Digestive discussion, current reader lines 31-34; the embedded wheat comparison is in line 32.
design.unknown_after_source: The source supplies a reported qualitative contrast, not measurements, a general chemical law or a target binding. It is unknown whether any future complete written account expresses processing-linked capacity rather than only product names.

proposed_content_schema.processing: PRODUCT_OF(input_portion, explicit_processing_kind) introduces the resulting product and preserves the input kind and processing relation; it neither equates two physical portions nor assumes unchanged material state.
proposed_content_schema.capacity: CAPACITY(product, abscess_maturation, polarity) attributes the stated power to that resulting product. The source contrast fixes positive for the chewed-wheat case and negative for the pounded-wheat case, within this account.
proposed_content_schema.composition: CAPACITY(PRODUCT_OF(wheat_portion, chewing), abscess_maturation, positive) differs from the otherwise analogous pounding case. Processing history remains an argument relevant to the downstream attribution.
proposed_content_schema.event_boundary: Possessing a power is not an actual application, successful cure, elapsed treatment or completed maturation. Those would require extra written content and are not supplied by this comparison.
proposed_content_schema.measurement_limit: No equal particle size, equal dose, controlled saliva exposure, identical initial specimen or mechanistic explanation is claimed. The matched feature is starting material kind, not all physical properties.
proposed_content_schema.generalization_limit: No inference for all foods, all chewing, all pounded preparations or all diseases. This single source comparison cannot prove a general processing algebra.

connected_cases.input: Wheat portion A explicitly processed by chewing
connected_cases.consequence: In the selected source account, the resulting product has the named maturation capacity. A later capacity reference must attach to that product rather than to wheat independently of preparation.

connected_cases.input: Wheat portion B explicitly processed by pounding
connected_cases.consequence: The contrasted product lacks that named capacity. Substituting the processing argument therefore changes the stated downstream capacity, even though both inputs have the wheat kind.

rivals.name: Independent product names
rivals.contract: Use separate terms for chewed wheat and pounded wheat and assign the two capacities directly.
rivals.distinguishing_consequence: This retains the source facts and remains equivalent unless a whole written derivation supplies reusable processing syntax and product reference. Naming alone is not a failure.

rivals.name: One mechanically reduced wheat state
rivals.contract: Erase the processing distinction after either operation and attach capacity only to the common wheat or reduced-food kind.
rivals.distinguishing_consequence: It cannot preserve the source's opposite capacity attributions without restoring an explicit processing or product distinction.

rivals.name: Capacity as actual effect
rivals.contract: Read the positive capacity assertion as a completed therapeutic event.
rivals.distinguishing_consequence: It adds an application, patient and realized outcome absent from the embedded comparison. A fixed descendant must bind them separately or retain modal capacity.

costs.unbound: Every target product, portion, processing value, capacity term, polarity, reference and ordered construction. None is presumed to occupy one token.

design.known_overlap: IDEA000565 already concerns product provenance, and IDEA000567 stage/site composition is already known. Novelty, if any, is only the source's downstream capacity contrast under two processing histories; a product-history card without this full dependency would be duplicative. Neither predecessor is reopened here.
design.minimum_next_step: Root must first compare the complete provenance, modifier and stage/site predecessors. If the downstream capacity contrast is already covered, leave this raw card as a source reuse pointer. Otherwise author one complete admitted account with both processing/product and capacity ownership before contemplating an executor.
design.decision_changing_result: A complete written product reference that carries the preparation distinction into opposite capacity assertions would give the processing construction a consequence beyond naming a stage or organ. If the distinction exists only in external commentary or arbitrary product labels, no compositional advantage has been established; capacity-to-success conflation rejects that descendant.
assumptions: The medieval capacity assertion is possible historical content, not a claim of present medical efficacy.
PRODUCT_OF is a new analytical proposal, not target morphology.
The comparison uses two conceptual portions of one material kind; no impossible simultaneous chewing and pounding of one unchanged portion is assumed.
